subject.title: perf: avoid event-loop stall during embedded_run bootstrap-context

question: Should this PR's custom yielding walker replace Node fs.glob for bootstrap-extra-files in the embedded-run bootstrap path despite the compatibility-sensitive traversal and ordering tradeoffs?
rationale: The code appears correct and tested, but accepting a custom glob implementation for a plugin-exposed bootstrap configuration path is an owner-level upgrade risk choice that green focused tests cannot fully settle.

options.title: Accept the yielding walker
options.body: Proceed after exact-head gates pass, accepting the custom walker as the bounded fix for bootstrap-context event-loop stalls while preserving the documented public SDK shape.

options.title: Require broader upgrade proof
options.body: Ask for one more live or Crabbox scenario with a large real workspace and broad bootstrap-extra-files config before merge.

options.title: Pause for an alternate design
options.body: Hold the PR if maintainers prefer keeping Node fs.glob and solving responsiveness at a different scheduling or worker boundary.

recommendation.title: Accept the yielding walker
recommendation.body: Proceed after exact-head gates pass, accepting the custom walker as the bounded fix for bootstrap-context event-loop stalls while preserving the documented public SDK shape.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans boundary-safe bootstrap reads, hook architecture, and public plugin surface compatibility, all paths where steipete has feature-history ownership signals.
